slides.title: You came alone. **Who do you walk up to?**
slides.sub: Twenty minutes of break. A room full of strangers holding coffee.
slides.say: So... nice weather for a conference?

slides.label: Run 1
slides.caption: Most of us pick whoever is nearest the urn. Or nobody, and answer emails.
slides.say: I'll just check my inbox. Again.

slides.label: Run 2
slides.caption: Before the day you saw who's coming: three heads of events, two venue managers, one from a museum.
slides.say: The museum one. Definitely the museum one.

slides.label: Why it changes
slides.caption: Walking up to the wrong stranger costs ten of your twenty minutes.

slides.text: Same room. Same twenty minutes. A completely different break.
